paid_required_for: kAIxU or any other AI/model call
provider-backed generation, embedding, transcription, image, video, or campaign copy work
hosted storage, backup, recovery, profile sync, or durable custody beyond local browser storage
external publishing, social posting, distributor/DSP handoff, route provider actions, payment movement, identity checks, email, SMS, or notification provider sends

paid platform imports such as SkyeAPI + AegisCore, SovereignDocs, CodeStudio, Code Evaluator, SkyeVaultPro, Doctor Ops, Documorph, SkyeArcade, SkyeBox hosted recovery, JobPing runtime, and kAIxU Storefront checkout use
white-label resale, customer tenant provisioning, custom domain mirroring, branded client portals, or selling access to the 0S as if it were the buyer's own platform

paid_lanes.price_path: SkyeCard AI Boost, SkyeGateFS27 usage top-up, kAIxU Starter/Team/Scale, and metered kAIxU rates

paid_lanes.label: White-label / resale / tenant platform use
paid_lanes.price_path: Enterprise / Managed Gate or custom quote; never Free99

default_paid_platform_posture: pending owner-approved SKU, bundle entitlement, or quote before usage is enabled

metering_contract.cost_rule: Every billable action must carry platform_id and usage_lane so FS27 can separate caps, rate limits, invoices, and owner review by product surface.
